notes: SR40 Aerin (aerin.com), Home Decor scope only (Home>Decor, Home>Tabletop&Bar, Lighting - same department scoping the prior Furniture pass used; Beauty/Fashion excluded). ACCESS: direct HTTP and Playwright to www.aerin.com are blocked by PerimeterX (403 px-captcha) on every route, confirmed again this pass. CORS proxies (api.allorigins.win, codetabs, cors.eu.org, whateverorigin) that worked for the prior Furniture pass were all failing (500/520/522/timeouts) this session, likely from heavy concurrent load by other parallel workers using the same shared proxies. Used Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3) as last resort per brief, in a heavily contended shared browser session (tab group churned repeatedly mid-task; retried tab operations per instructions). Pages rendered fine and returned genuine PerimeterX-free content once loaded via the real browser. NAVIGATION DISCOVERY: main nav (Labor Day Sale/New Arrivals/The Edit/Home/Lighting/Fashion/Beauty/Personalization/Collaborations/Gifts) has no direct 'Bestsellers' top-level link; found via web search of aerin.com then verified each candidate by opening it. Confirmed 3 genuine, separate Bestsellers PLPs, one per department branch used by the site's own taxonomy (Home>Decor, Home>Tabletop&Bar, Lighting) - each is a real Magento/Klevu category page with breadcrumb, Refine/Sort toolbar, and a real product grid, not editorial. QTY SOURCE: each page's Klevu 'categoryProductViewTracking' analytics beacon (fired client-side, captured via network-request inspection) carries klevu_categoryPath, klevu_totalResults, and the full klevu_productIds list for that exact page load - klevu_totalResults matched the count of unique productIds every time, and each page showed only a single results page (pagination indicator '1' alone), confirming these are true totals, not just the first page's limit. No 4th 'all-department' Bestsellers landing page exists in scope: https://www.aerin.com/new-arrivals/bestsellers/ (found via search snippet) is a 404; the site's only unified index is the Beauty bestsellers page (out of scope) and these 3 department leaves - no parent grouping page unites just the 3 in-scope leaves, so they are emitted as siblings, not parent+children.
